thread:
mira: Quick follow-up from PM: postmortem notes from Tue outage (model-registry auth + cloud token storm). Need concrete owners and timelines for outstanding actions. High-level: 1) auth token rotation + emergency fallback 2) model-registry client retry/backoff + caching 3) cloud rate-limit SLA + multi-region failover. Please add owners and ETA. Link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/postmortem/26449 :white_check_mark:

sam: I can take #2 (client retries & circuit breaker). Plan: add exponential backoff + jitter, add metrics (retry_count, cb_open). PR by 2026-04-05. Will mock in staging and run synthetic jobs.

camille: I'll own #1 (auth rotation + fallback). Security to review KMS integration. Proposed tasks: shorten token TTL to 10m, add fallback to cached read-only token when auth fails, automate rotate keys. ETA: 2026-03-30. @mira please sync on compliance window.

alex: For #3 I'll coordinate with infra and cloud reps. Need contractual rate-limit increase and a runbook for region failover. ETA: initial vendor conversation by 2026-03-28, config rollout 2 weeks after.

jess: I'll update runbook and add a scheduled DR drill to test this flow. Proposed drill window: 2026-04-12. Also adding a post-drill retrospective.

mira: Thanks all. Can each owner add a one-line task to the issue tracker and tag `incident:vendor-dep-mitigation`? I'll consolidate into the weekly ops doc.

sam: Added issue #4567 -> 'model-registry: implement retry + cb' (https://tracker.internal/issue/4567)

camille: Added issue #4570 -> 'auth: TTL rotate + fallback + KMS integration' (https://tracker.internal/issue/4570)

alex: Created ticket #4574 -> 'cloud: vendor SLA & multi-region failover plan' (https://tracker.internal/issue/4574)

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-24T15:08:14Z marked RESOLVED by @mira. Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2645001234

sam: Test snippet for retries I used in staging:
```bash
python test_retry.py --target model-registry --concurrency 10 --fail-rate 0.3
```

camille: Security notes: must get approval from @sec-team for KMS key policy changes. I'll request review today.

mira: Quick check: owners, ETAs, tracker numbers and drill date in thread. I'll follow up in ops sync on Mon. If no objections, closing this-follow-up in 2 weeks when tickets have a PR.

jess: No objections. :thumbsup:

alex: Fine by me.

camille: Fine. Starting work today.
